chance: Semantic events indexed by game/group/seat. Crit and damage use the sealed exact Showdown uint32 maps; ties use an unbiased bit between tied seats. Accuracy has no misses in this profile. No sodium stream or raw draw schedule equivalence claim.
view: Own private roster and exact stats/HP/PP; opponent seen species, last public percentage HP and active member; complete bounded public move/switch action history with observer-relative actors. No opponent speed variant, exact HP/PP, reserve species before reveal, RNG, winner label or opponent action commitment.
cutoff: Finish faint replacements, then truncate at the fresh turn-13 joint boundary. Bootstrap each player's last transition with its own turn-13 value under the frozen collecting actor, never call a cutoff a draw. Reset the truncated game explicitly. Terminal rewards win1/loss0; no dense reward.
acceptance: Zero scalar/JAX/reference state, event, mask and compact player-view divergences; existing information counterfactuals and positive reveal controls pass; finite categorical PPO updates, no masked samples, same-player GAE, exact supported checkpoint replay. No strength threshold or full G2/G3/G4 closure.
scope: New additive CPU-only modules; sealed predecessors unchanged. No public server, final reserved data, GPU or Prime. Learner smoke starts only after simulator and information parity pass. A separate sustained qualification and learning-strength evaluation remain future gates.
categorical_policy: Four leaves of a two-level binary tree. Each node uses the sealed FP32 rare mass floor 2^-24 and exact 64-bit word threshold; leaves are products of root/child conditional masses. Stored and PPO log probabilities sum those same logs. Independent words per node. No rounded CDF or straight-through quantizer.
